output.subject: Re: I was profiled at your branch: we have received your complaint
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for taking the time to write to us. We have received your complaint, and we want you to know that it has been read carefully.

You told us that on September 8 you visited our Lantern Hill branch to open a savings account for your son. You mentioned that the banker kept asking where your husband was and whether he "approved" of the account, and finally said it would be "easier" if he came in himself. You pointed out that you have your own income and your own accounts with us, and that you do not believe a man would have been asked those questions. You have asked us for an explanation of what happened.

We understand that this visit left you feeling profiled, and we're sorry for the distress this experience has caused you.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint and will look into the points you have raised. They will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Acknowledge-only reply: confirm it takes no position on whether the banker's conduct was discriminatory.
Check whether the son's savings account was opened or is still pending, and whether the customer needs help completing it.
The complaint gives no year for Sept 8; confirm the visit date before the specialist team responds.
Confirm the specialist team has the case and can meet the 10-business-day response.
Customer's main request is an explanation of the banker's conduct; make sure the substantive reply addresses it directly.
